title: Superb Connacht secure play-off spot and book Champions Cup for next season
desc: Connacht produced a stunning first-half performance at Hive Stadium to defeat Edinburgh and secure the final URC playoff place, while also booking their return to the Champions Cup next season. The victory, coupled with Ulster’s agonising last-gasp defeat to Glasgow at Ravenhill Stadium and Cardiff’s win over the Stormers at Arms Park, ensured Connacht extended their campaign. Their playoff place could potentially come at the expense of their Belfast rivals, who will have to wait on the outcome of Munster's game against the Lions.
